preconditions.expression: all(x in range(1, N+1) for x in P)
preconditions.description: P is a permutation of length N, containing all elements from 1 to N exactly once.
The number of test cases T is in the range [1, 100].
The length of the permutation N is in the range [2, 500].
The sum of N over all test cases won't exceed 500.

postconditions.description: The output minimum total cost to sort the permutation in increasing order is correct.
The output number of operations required to sort the permutation is correct.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= N and 1 <= j <= N and i != j and P[i-1] > P[j-1] for i, j in output_operations)
postconditions.description: The output operations are valid swaps that sort the permutation in increasing order.
